question: Two trains having lengths of 450 m and 350 m are running at speeds of 80 km/h and 110 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. The time taken (in minutes) by the faster train, coming from behind, to completely cross the other train is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed = 110 − 80 = 30 km/h = 30 × (5/18) = 25/3 m/s.

Total distance to cross = 450 + 350 = 800 m.

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed = 800 ÷ (25/3) = 96 seconds.

Time in minutes = 96 ÷ 60 = 1.6 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.6 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of slower train (L₁) = 450 m

Length of faster train (L₂) = 350 m

Speed of slower train (V₁) = 80 km/h

Speed of faster train (V₂) = 110 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = V₂ − V₁

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (5/18)

Time taken = Total length ÷ Relative speed

 Total Distance to Cross = 450 m + 350 m = 800 m

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative speed = 110 − 80 = 30 km/h

⇒ Relative speed in m/s = 30 × (5/18) = 150/18 = 25/3 m/s

⇒ Total distance to be covered = L₁ + L₂ = 450 + 350 = 800 m

⇒ Time taken = 800 ÷ (25/3)

⇒ Time taken = (800 × 3) ÷ 25 = 2400 ÷ 25 = 96 seconds

⇒ Time taken in minutes = 96 ÷ 60 = 1.6 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 1.6 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds (V₂ − V₁).

Trains Moving in Opposite Directions

If two trains are moving in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (V₁ + V₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.
